# gm-api

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from services/gm-api/servlet/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/gm-api.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `gm-api` component of `services/gm-api/servlet`, read by package `au.com.idpartners.gm.servlet`: generated from its catalogue, [gm-api.json](../../services/gm-api/servlet/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/gm-api.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `GM_API` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdpUrl` (init-param `pdpUrl`, then env `AUTHZEN_BASE_URL`) | Unset; an http or https URL | The AuthZEN PDP's base URL for the grants and MCP servlets; /access/v1/evaluation is appended. Then AUTHZEN_BASE_URL; the shipped web.xml sets it (http://host.docker.internal:9099), so AUTHZEN_BASE_URL is never read unless web.xml is edited (F-0238). It must be https unless OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=development: the PDP's answers decide every evaluation and its bearer token travels with each request | **Doesn't start**: Unset, or not an http or https URL: the servlet does not start. http under the production profile: GM_API is FAILED_CONFIG, the reason naming pdpUrl, and its endpoints answer 503 | Any | Yes |
| `pdpToken` (init-param `pdpToken`, then env `AUTHZEN_BEARER_TOKEN`) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The bearer token sent to a protected PDP; then AUTHZEN_BEARER_TOKEN | **Per request**: Wrong: the PDP refuses every evaluation | Any | Yes |
| `audience` (init-param `audience`, then env `GM_AUDIENCE`) | Unset | The aud this API answers to, the access token manager's audience claim; then GM_AUDIENCE; the shipped web.xml sets it, so GM_AUDIENCE is never read unless web.xml is edited (F-0238) | **Doesn't start**: Unset: the servlet does not start; wrong, every token is a 401 | Any | Yes |
| `pdpTimeoutMs` (init-param) | `10000`; milliseconds, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | How long the grants and MCP servlets wait for the PDP | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the servlet does not start | Any | No |
| `issuer` (init-param) | Unset | The issuer the metadata servlet advertises; unset, none is | **Not checked**: Advertised as written | Any | No |
| `grantManagementEndpoint` (init-param) | Unset; an http or https URL | The grant_management_endpoint the metadata servlet advertises; <request base>/gm-api/grants when unset | **Doesn't start**: Not an http or https URL: the metadata servlet does not start, naming it; otherwise advertised as written | Any | No |
